Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review

  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Senior Data Quality & Governance Engineer
description:
Bold Metrics is the leading fit and sizing solution on the market today for the world’s top retailers and brands. We are a venture-backed startup that is making a big impact on the environment, forever changing the landscape of eCommerce. We are a remote-first company that is full of inspiring and friendly people.

We are currently searching for a Senior Data Quality Engineer to join our fast-growing team. This position is for someone located in São Paulo, Brazil who is able to come into the office in-person at least once weekly. In this position, you will have the opportunity to work with some of our biggest projects within the retail industry.

About You:

You are a humble, passionate, and experienced engineer that is looking for a collaborative and analytical Data Quality Engineering role to support the execution of our product deliveries and client reporting services. This comprises validating the data flow as a whole, from data sources to data consumers, including BI dashboards and ML models.

As our Senior Data Quality Engineer, you are an extremely detail-oriented, out-of-the-box problem solver with a commitment to doing high-quality work. You will work with the Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams to support the flow of cleaned, quality data to ultimately drive customer success.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Lead the data quality engineering team and efforts across the organization
  • Identify metrics used to measure data quality
  • Establish data validations that cover both functional and domain-specific KPI data
  • Monitor data quality metrics and perform root cause analysis of data quality issues, taking appropriate steps to address any issues
  • Make sure that data quality processes are integrated into the data architecture
  • Support all the data governance initiatives
  • Understand the data and KPI reporting requirements for clients, ensuring that the data quality initiatives align

Skills and Qualifications: (even if you do not meet these skills 100%, we still welcome you to apply)

  • BSc or MSc in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or related field
  • 6+ years’ experience in data engineering and quality assessment roles
  • High level of proficiency with Python and SQL
  • Some experience with DBT would be a bonus
  • A strong understanding of data management concepts including data profiling and mapping
  • Skilled in performing data quality assessments to identify data inconsistencies, inaccuracies, and incompleteness in data products
  • Strong analytical skills to identify patterns and trends in data and data quality issues
  • Good understanding of data governance concepts including data privacy and security
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, identifying areas for improvement within the data quality process and workflows
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve data quality issues, including identifying the root cause of problems and implementing effective solutions
  • Above-bar communication skills, both written and oral, to interface in a collaborative team environment
  • Well-organized individual that pays close attention to detail
  • Able to effectively prioritize in a fast-paced and fast-changing environment
  • Bonus if you have experience integrating with large retail e-commerce sites

About Us:

Bold Metrics, established in 2017, is a SaaS solution for retailers and brands to reduce returns, improve sustainability and supercharge their supply chain from the ground up. Using a comprehensive set of machine learning and AI technologies to accurately capture customer body measurements, we help apparel brands unlock the power of body data to meet the demands of today's increasingly personalized world.

Learn more about us at boldmetrics.com

We strive to create a place to work where we all feel safe, empowered, engaged, and inspired. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to offering employment that is based upon personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

Position Summary
Bentley Systems is seeking a talented individual to become a valued member of the Product Support team as a Technical Support Engineer. As part of the Global Technical Support team, the technical support engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance on the product via (inbound/outbound) phone, e-mail, and web portal. This is a hands-on position that will interface with our users as well as our development, professional services, and sales departments. The position is responsible for problem analysis, documentation, resolution, and escalation involving Bentley’s supported products
We Will Rely On You For The Following

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.
  • Assist with all facets of Bentley users and technical support by helping to identify user issues by isolating and resolving the issue or by proper escalation.
  • Advise and educate users on accurate usage of the Product and address specific use cases reported on the Service Requests.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your Daily Tasks Will Look Like This
  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.
  • Contribute to Bentley Communities and answer user queries.
  • Update the Team Technical Knowledge Base and share updates with the team.
  • Upskill on Product Knowledge by focusing on a new topic every week. Consume Training through internal Pathways, Wikis, videos, etc.
  • Channelize potential Defects/Enhancements to the Product Management/Development teams.
  • Provide a handover to the next shift with appropriate documentation when needed

What You Bring To The Team
  • 2+ years of experience in technical support and exposure to global user interaction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience or Knowledge with ProjectWise product suites or similar document management systems such as Documentum, Vault or Aconex.
  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What Would Make You Stand Out
  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)

What We Offer
  • A great Team and culture – please see our Recruitment Video.
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction.
  • Competitive Salary and benefits.
  • The opportunity to work within a global and diverse international team.
  • A supportive and collaborative environment.
  • Colleague Recognition Awards.

Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.
The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.
Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.
We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What Impact Can You Make In This Role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.
What You Will Do As An Analyst

  • Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
  • Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
  • Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
  • Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
  • Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.

What makes you a successful candidate?
  • Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
  • Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
  • Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
  • You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
  • Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.

Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.
We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

description:
São Paulo - SP

ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS

  1. Executar os procedimentos privativos e relacionados a práticas avançadas de enfermagem como interagir com pais/ responsáveis antes, durante e após procedimentos, orientações realizadas, realizar e orientar diluições e rediluições de medicamentos conforme faixa etária/ peso/ restrição hídrica, realizar punção venosa considerando protocolo de punção difícil para todas as crianças, acompanhar pacientes em exames com sedação e realizar procedimentos invasivos específicos como punção venosa, atendimento de urgência;
  2. Realizar procedimentos invasivos preferencialmente em dupla através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas institucionais;
  3. Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional;
  4. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  5. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura;
  6. Aprazar e conferir os itens de prescrição médica para continuidade da assistência segura;
  7. Reconhecer e priorizar de acordo com a complexidade assistencial as situações de emergência mediante a necessidade de cada paciente, direcionando a assistência a ser prestada, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as normas, regulamentos e legislações pertinentes às áreas de atuação, contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação e de manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares;
  8. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares;
  9. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes internados no HSC;
  10. Participação ativa em visita multidisciplinar buscando o alinhamento das necessidades assistenciais dos pacientes e familiares sob sua responsabilidade;
  11. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas e contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador, através de educação em atividades baseadas em normas, protocolos e procedimentos institucionais, visando a atualização e aperfeiçoamento da equipe de enfermagem;
  12. Realizar o acompanhamento e treinamento de colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial;
  13. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais;
  14. Exercer as atividades baseado nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde através do cumprimento das metas de segurança do paciente;
  15. Participar dos treinamentos e eventos institucionais pertinentes ao cargo;
  16. Multiplicar informações relacionadas a boas práticas assistenciais junto a equipe multidisciplinar de área de atuação, promovendo e difundindo medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente;
  17. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada;
  18. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.

Sobre a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC)

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a ACSC é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Na Amazon, estamos trabalhando para ser a empresa mais centrada no cliente do mundo. No estágio de Análise de Negócios, você trabalhará em uma de nossas equipes de serviços de inteligência, varejo ou vendas. O estágio é uma oportunidade de aprender e entender os processos, aprimorar as habilidades analíticas e contribuir para impactar nos negócios da Amazon.

Na Amazon, damos a você as ferramentas para assumir seu projeto e aprender de forma real.


O Centro de Distribuição da Amazon está localizado em Cajamar - SP. Para essa posição, o estagiário trabalhará presencialmente 5x por semana.


Key job responsibilities

  1. Aprender como melhorar o sucesso dentro de uma função de negócios, analisando dados, descobrindo e resolvendo problemas do mundo real e construindo métricas e casos de negócios para melhorar a experiência do cliente.

  3. Aprender a trabalhar com grandes volumes e big data, em um negócio altamente complexo.
  4. Aprender a trabalhar com ferramentas de inteligência de negócios, acessar e trabalhar com big data de várias fontes e fazer parceria com áreas da empresa para identificar oportunidades estratégicas.

  1. Atualmente matriculado em um bacharelado em matemática, engenharia, estatística, ciência da computação, administração ou áreas similares com data de conclusão de graduação entre Julho de 2026 e Dezembro de 2027.

description:

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Technician, Senior – Transportation/Right-of-Way Group role at Hennepin County

This range is provided by Hennepin County. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$59,508.16/yr - $89,262.25/yr

Description
Hennepin County Public Works is seeking a Senior Engineering Technician to join the Right-of-Way Group of the Design Division within the Transportation Project Delivery department. This position will work as part of a team to coordinate between engineers, appraisers, agents and attorneys for Right-of Way Acquisitions on roadway reconstruction projects with opportunities for professional and technical growth through training and working with other experienced roadway design and acquisition professionals.
Current Hennepin County employees who refer a candidate hired into an open competitive position may be eligible for a $500 referral bonus. For more information visit employee referral program .
Find us here at upcoming career fairs!
Location and hours:
This position is hybrid and will be located at the Public Works Facility, 1600 Prairie Drive, Medina, MN 55340 and remote, as job duties require. There is no public transportation to this facility. Work hours are flexible between 6 a.m. and 6 p.m., Monday through Friday. While this position is designated as hybrid, based on current requirements hires must live in or relocate to Minnesota or Wisconsin.
New Employee Orientation (NEO) for all new benefit-earning employees is in-person in downtown Minneapolis. Details about NEO will be provided upon hire.
About The Position Type
This is a full-time, benefit-earning position.
This position is internally classified as an Engineering Technician, Senior.
Click here to view the job classification specification.
In This Position, You Will

  • Set up parcel files in Canyon and L:drive for agents, including R/W Cert #1 subfolders.
  • Create parcel exhibits based on MicroStation CAD drawings.
  • Assist attorneys with Commissioner hearings and trial exhibits.
  • Review a high volume of Tech 4 drafted legal descriptions to ensure a high level of accuracy used for appraisal, condemnation petition, recorder’s office and surveyor’s office to map in County GIS.
  • Identify legal descriptions with complexities that may need to be reviewed by HC Surveyor’s Office to ensure high quality legal descriptions of land acquired by the County.
  • Provide guidance with post-closing file review to ensure standardize documents are retained and duplicate documents are deleted.
  • Assist with RoW/GIS database to visually capture permanent interest in a central repository.
  • Verify easement shapes with Legal Descriptions using Net Deed Plotter software.
Need To Have
  • One of the following:
    • Five years or more experience in technical non-professional highway, land survey, geographic information systems application, or related engineering work, including specialized experience in the function performed.
    • Current Certified Survey Technician (CST) Level 3
    • GIS Professional Certification (GISP)
    • Licensed Land Surveyor in Training (LSIT).
  • Note: One of the following may be substituted for one year of the required experience:
    • Completion of an approved highway/civil engineering technology or land surveying training program.
    • 30 college semester credits in mathematics, geography, computer science or engineering-related technical courses.
  • A valid driver's license and the ability to obtain a Hennepin County driver's permit .
Nice To Have
  • Experience:
    • With terrain surface and/or roadway drainage and storm sewer design using roadway design software.
    • Directing a work team and/or coordinating work with other functional groups/disciplines.
    • Utilizing complex computer software, such as CAD (OpenRoads, InRoads, Geopak, Civil 3D or equivalent), GIS, spreadsheets, or databases.
    • Using ArcPro GIS software.
  • Ability to:
    • Use critical thinking to make decisions based on established guidelines.
    • Read and interpret MnDOT Standard Design Manuals and Technical Memos, construction plans, specifications, and other written forms.
    • Schedule, prioritize, and balance several tasks/projects.
    • Work independently and in teams with minimal lead worker direction.
    • Communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
About The Department
We envision a Transportation Department whose members are respectful of one another and the public we serve and are committed to the delivery of a safe, high-quality transportation network. We are widely trusted and recognized for innovation, collaboration and the responsible use of resources.
About Hennepin County
Hennepin is the largest county government organization in Minnesota. Our employees work every day to improve the health, safety and quality of life for our residents and communities. All of our jobs align with our mission to serve residents through transformative services that reduce disparities, eliminate inequities, and create opportunity for all and our vision of a community where all people are healthy, all people are valued, and all people thrive.
Our employees receive a combination of competitive benefits and positive workplace culture not found at other organizations. This includes meaningful work that impacts our community, competitive pay, work-life balance, a variety of benefits and opportunities to grow. Learn more at The Bridge (login as Guest).
Hennepin County envisions an organization where our commitment to diversity and the reduction of disparities is fundamental in providing excellent service to our community.

description:
Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing, with a global team of over 1200 colleagues in 75+ countries, mostly remote, with few office-based roles.

Role Overview

The Customer Success department at Canonical is strategic, aiming to reduce risk and churn, facilitate product adoption, and support account expansion. Customer Success Managers (CSMs) develop trust with customers, understand their objectives, and align expectations to enhance loyalty and satisfaction. They also identify additional service opportunities and help craft collaboration roadmaps.

Team Structure & Responsibilities

  • Specialized in segments: Mass, Focus, Step Growth, and support for unassigned customers including Store clients.
  • Onboard new customers, introducing products like Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, and data applications.
  • Coordinate complex projects with developers, IT managers, and decision-makers across industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Support to develop engagement plans.
  • Manage customer portfolios, identify growth opportunities, and mitigate renewal risks.
  • Lead weekly customer and business reviews, prioritize blockers, and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Advocate for customers internally, influencing product roadmaps, documentation, and processes.
  • Support customers through reactive ticketing and create targeted campaigns.

Candidate Profile

Ideal candidates will have at least 5 years of IT-related experience, with familiarity in Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud, networking, security, migration, or IoT. Strong presentation skills, process improvement experience, and team collaboration are essential. Knowledge of agile methodologies and proficiency in English, with additional languages like Spanish and Portuguese, are highly valued.

Additional Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira, and CRM tools is a plus.

What We Offer

Competitive global compensation, annual reviews, bonuses, and benefits including learning budgets, wellness programs, travel opportunities, and flexible work arrangements. The role is remote, with periodic in-person team sprints.

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source innovation, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a diverse, inclusive workplace. Working here is future-oriented, encouraging continuous learning and growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity and are committed to providing fair opportunities regardless of background or identity.

title: IT Solutions Release Manager - Mid-senior
description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
  • Facilitate release activities across all releases, mainly with ensuring quality, timely deployments across environments
  • Maintains the release schedule for all core services and ensure alignment across key partners and vendors.
  • Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates
  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus
  • Knowledge on MS Project, Excel-Macros
  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
    Desired Technical Stack:
  • Platforms : Windows, Linux.
  • Database : MSSQL
  • Ticketing Tools: Service now
  • Cloud Environment : MS Azure
  • CI and Build Deployment Tools : Octopus Deploy
  • Version Control Tool : Azure Devops
  • Monitoring tools : Grafana
Additional Information

Working hours:
Monday to Friday - 08:00 to 17:00 Hybrid Work

title: Trainmaster (CVRR)
description:
Supervises and coordinates activities of train crew engaged in switching railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to facilitate loading or unloading of cars or making up and breaking up of trains; and/or switches railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to load and unload cars or to make up or break up trains in a safe and efficient manner, by performing the following duties.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

  • Supervises and coordinates the activities of train crews.
  • Receives oral or written instructions from Manager or Customer indicating which cars are to be switched.
  • Notifies train crew of switching orders and, whereby, which cars are to be moved to specified locations of yard, using radio, telephone, verbal, or hand signals.
  • Manage cars online through various RMI reports.
  • Must ensure daily train lists are accurate as generated by the customer service department, and accurate as completed by the train crews within his/her territory.
  • Must ensure all reporting is done accurately and timely, including daily crew work sheets and weekly operational reporting.
  • Approve all man hours under his/her area of responsibility and forward these hours to the necessary personnel or department on a timely basis.
  • Initiate and provide an accurate, complete, and timely investigation of all accidents and incidents, including causes, remedial action, and recommended solutions.
  • Understand the quantitative factors contributing to the major costs on the railroad and understand the extent of their effect toward financial performances.
  • Adjust locomotive consist requirements based on HP and trailing tons daily, with a goal to minimize locomotive fuel and maximize locomotive utilization.
  • Understand all outstanding track conditions within his/her territory, including slow orders, and their effect on productivity/efficiency.
  • Demonstrate predictable, reliable, and timely attendance.
  • Knowledge of and skills in applying basic federal railroad regulations, guidelines, and rules.
  • Ability to read and comprehend written safety rules, procedure and safety manuals, government regulations, operating and maintenance instructions, memos, and other work-related information.
  • Ability to apply commonsense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, diagrammatic, or schedule form; and/or to apply principles of logic to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions; and/or to apply principles of rational systems to solve practical problems.
  • Ability to effectively communicate instructions, directions, processes, procedures, safety rules and regulations to co-workers, supervisors, and others in written, oral, diagrammatic and schedule form.
  • Ability to train switch crews and other yard personnel to perform job-related duties; and to provide training related to federal and company regulations, rules, safety guidelines and preventive maintenance.
  • Ability to make independent judgments using sound reasoning skills and knowledge base.
  • Ability to think and act quickly in responding to emergency and non-emergency situations.
  • Ability to talk to and effectively communicate with co-workers, yard personnel, switching crew, engineers, railroad officials and others in a clear, concise, courteous, efficient, and professional manner.
  • Promote and facilitate company safety initiatives and instill a culture of safety
  • Manages the operational testing program by observing, documenting, and evaluating safe work practices and rules compliance
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.
  • Performs other duties as requested or required

Machines, Tools, Special Equipment, Personal Protective Equipment Used:

  • PPE; hard hat, vest, safety glasses, FR clothing, gloves, steel toed boots

Education and Experience:

  • High school education or general education development (GED), and minimum of 6 months job-related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.

Certificates and Licenses:

  • Must hold, and continue to hold, a current locomotive engineers and conductor’s certification.

Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The team member is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions and elements, noise, and fumes from gas, oil, and grease.

Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by team members assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

Na área de máquinas pesadas, são oferecidos cursos de operação de pá carregadeira e retroescavadeira. As inscrições podem ser feitas gratuitamente por telefone, pelos números (44) 99965-5165 e (44) 3628-2553, ou presencialmente na Agência do Trabalhador de Jussara durante o horário comercial. As vagas são limitadas e preenchidas por ordem de inscrição, o que exige agilidade dos interessados.

Os cursos serão ministrados na própria cidade, com estrutura e suporte do SENAR, que visa capacitar a população para atender às demandas do mercado de trabalho e promover o desenvolvimento econômico local. title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer - React & Next.JS
description:
Conheça a 1GLOBAL

A 1GLOBAL é uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora que atua na interseção entre telecomunicações e tecnologia. Fundada por dois empreendedores visionários, Hakan Koç e Pyrros Koussios, a 1GLOBAL é uma empresa privada com uma missão clara: conectar o mundo de forma integrada e eficiente . Com mais de 100 milhões de dólares em receita e um crescimento contínuo, somos uma empresa sólida e independente, capaz de financiar nossa expansão de maneira sustentável.

Como provedora global especializadas em telecomunicações, a 1GLOBAL atende diversas áreas como instituições financeiras, operadoras de redes móveis e consumidores em 42 países. Oferecemos serviços regulados de voz, dados e SMS. Somos pioneiros na revolução de eSIMs, construindo um ecossistema completo que nos impulsiona ao lado de parceiros como Apple, Palo Alto Networks e Google, além de clientes renomados como Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Revolut, Netflix e Tesla.

E agora, estamos abrindo um Hub de Tecnologia em São Paulo, Brasil e buscamos talentos que estejam dispostos a nos ajudar a conectar o mundo de forma integrada.

Junte-se a nós!

Sobre a vaga

A 1GLOBAL está em busca de uma Pessoa Engenheira de Software – Frontend com experiência em React e Next.js para se juntar à nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Frontend, você será responsável por desenvolver e manter nossas aplicações web, garantindo uma excelente experiência do usuário e alta performance. Você trabalhará em colaboração com as equipes de design e backend para implementar funcionalidades e otimizar as aplicações para velocidade e escalabilidade máximas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades para usuários utilizando React e Next.js;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de design para criar interfaces web intuitivas e responsivas;
  • Otimizar aplicações para performance e escalabilidade;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de backend para integrar APIs RESTful;
  • Escrever código eficiente, limpo e reutilizável;
  • Participar de revisões de código para manter a qualidade e garantir as melhores práticas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) com as tendências e tecnologias do setor.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento frontend com React e Next.js;
  • Proficiência em HTML, CSS, JavaScript e TypeScript;
  • Experiência com frameworks CSS como Tailwind;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de teste como Jest ou React Testing Library;
  • Experiência com design responsivo e mobile-first ;
  • Familiaridade com APIs RESTful, tanto no uso quanto na construção;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas modernas de build para frontend e fluxos de trabalho;
  • Compreensão de sistemas de controle de versão, como Git;
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas e solucionar bugs de forma eficaz;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe;
  • Experiência com pipelines CI/CD será considerada um diferencial;
  • Inglês Avançado.

Por que escolher a 1GLOBAL?

  • Oportunidades de Crescimento: Avance em sua carreira em uma das empresas de telecomunicações que mais cresce, com expansão de mais de 40% ano a ano sob a liderança de empreendedores de tecnologia.
  • Exposição Global e Multicultura: Você também terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um time multicultural, colaborando com pessoas de diferentes nacionalidades e experiências.
  • Cultura de Comunicação Aberta: Faça parte de uma equipe onde suas ideias são ouvidas e o diálogo é incentivado, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho transparente e colaborativo.
  • Exposição a Grandes Projetos: Participe ativamente de decisões que impactam o futuro da indústria de telecomunicações.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Dinâmico: Se prepare para estar em um ambiente acelerado e inovador, com pessoas comprometidas em transformar o universo de telecomunicações através de tecnologia.
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Trabalhe ao lado de um time talentoso que se apoie mutuamente, sempre pronto para elevar nosso nível e ajudar você a aprimorar suas habilidades, superando desafios e alcançando estes objetivos juntos.
  • Foco em Resultados: Contribua em um time orientado a resultados, que valoriza eficiência, criatividade e inovação.

A pessoa candidata selecionada terá a oportunidade de participar de um programa completo de onboarding e treinamento em Lisboa, Portugal, desenvolvendo habilidades valiosas enquanto vivencia a energia e o encanto de uma das cidades mais dinâmicas da Europa.

Na 1GLOBAL, acreditamos que um ambiente diverso e inclusivo é fundamental para nosso sucesso. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas e experiências que cada pessoa traz, para criar um espaço de respeito e colaboração. Aqui, buscamos promover uma cultura onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e possam contribuir com seu melhor, independentemente de origem, gênero, orientação sexual, etnia ou qualquer outra característica pessoal. Estamos sempre em busca de criar um ambiente onde todos possam crescer e se desenvolver juntos.

A área de dados oferece uma série de oportunidades desafiadoras e emocionantes, especialmente no que diz respeito à arquitetura de dados. Como parte de uma equipe dedicada, você estará envolvido em projetos que visam estruturar, integrar e governar dados de maneira eficiente e inovadora, com o objetivo de impactar diretamente o sucesso da empresa.

A crescente demanda por dados e informações exige arquiteturas escaláveis e flexíveis, e sua missão será criar soluções que garantam a capacidade de lidar com grandes volumes de dados de forma ágil e eficaz. Trabalhar com fontes de dados diversificadas, como sistemas internos, bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, além de APIs e outras plataformas, será uma oportunidade de aplicar e expandir suas habilidades na integração de dados.

A otimização da performance também será uma das suas missões. Ao integrar ferramentas analíticas avançadas, como business intelligence e machine learning, você contribuirá para o design de fluxos de dados que suportem análises em tempo real ou em batches de forma eficiente, sem sobrecarregar o sistema. Aqui, você terá a chance de aplicar suas habilidades em engenharia de dados para criar soluções robustas e de alta performance.

A evolução constante das necessidades do negócio será um estímulo para sua criatividade e inovação. Sua capacidade de adaptar e atualizar a arquitetura de dados para atender às novas demandas, tecnologias e fontes de dados será essencial, garantindo que a empresa esteja sempre à frente das tendências e preparada para o futuro.

Em resumo, a missão na área de dados será desafiadora, mas cheia de oportunidades de crescimento e impacto. Você terá a chance de moldar a arquitetura de dados de forma estratégica, promovendo eficiência, inovação e segurança, e tornando-se uma peça chave para o sucesso da organização. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, em constante evolução e com um grande potencial de impacto, essa é a oportunidade ideal para alavancar sua carreira na área de dados.

Na MadeiraMadeira acreditamos que a base para uma operação eficiente, escalável e orientada a dados é uma arquitetura sólida e moderna. O Arquiteto de Dados será responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir uma arquitetura de dados que suporte os desafios de um varejo digital dinâmico e em constante crescimento.

Seu papel será garantir que os dados estejam disponíveis, confiáveis e acessíveis para as áreas de negócio, produto e operações. Você liderará a transformação da infraestrutura de dados, promovendo governança robusta, integração ágil de dados e escalabilidade. O objetivo final é habilitar decisões mais rápidas e assertivas, reduzir perdas operacionais e impulsionar métricas críticas, como aumento do GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) e redução de custos logísticos.

O Que Estamos Procurando

Buscamos um profissional apaixonado por resolver problemas complexos de dados, com experiência em ambientes de alta escala e em iniciativas que conectem tecnologia e estratégia de negócios.

Venha transformar o futuro do e-commerce de casa com a gente.

  • Principais Responsabilidades
    • Planejamento e Implementação da Arquitetura de Dados :
      • Liderar a adoção da arquitetura de dados baseada no modelo Medalhão, habilitando domínios de dados conforme os princípios do Data Mesh.
      • Definir padrões e frameworks para a ingestão, processamento, armazenamento e consumo de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e eficiência.
    • Governança e Qualidade de Dados :
      • Implementar políticas e ferramentas de governança para garantir consistência, segurança e qualidade dos dados.
      • Estabelecer um modelo de single source of truth, minimizando redundâncias e inconsistências.
    • Colaboração Estratégica :
      • Trabalhar em parceria com times de engenharia, ciência de dados, produto e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções arquiteturais.
      • Garantir que a arquitetura de dados apoie iniciativas estratégicas, como personalização, otimização logística e redução de custos operacionais.
    • Inovação e Otimização Contínua :
      • Monitorar tendências e inovações em arquitetura de dados, avaliando tecnologias como data lakes, data warehouses e ferramentas de observabilidade.
      • Otimizar pipelines e fluxos de dados para melhorar desempenho e custo-benefício.
    • Mentoria e Liderança Técnica :
      • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, promovendo boas práticas e cultura de dados.
      • Servir como referência técnica em projetos críticos relacionados à arquitetura de dados.
Principais Ferramentas, Tecnologias e Padrões

O Arquiteto de Dados deve dominar uma ampla gama de ferramentas e tecnologias modernas para projetar e implementar soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio. Isso inclui ferramentas de processamento e orquestração de dados para garantir fluxos de dados automatizados e resilientes. Tecnologias de armazenamento e análise são essenciais para a construção de data lakes e warehouses performáticos. Além disso, o uso de frameworks distribuídos é indispensável para o processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real ou batch.

Em relação aos padrões de mercado, o arquiteto deve ter profundo conhecimento de arquiteturas como Data Lakehouse , Data Mesh , e Lambda/Kappa Architectures , que atendem às necessidades de escalabilidade, descentralização e processamento em tempo real. Domínio em governança e qualidade de dados e confiabilidade dos dados. Além disso, é esperado conhecimento em linguagens de programação bem como proficiência em SQL para modelagem e consulta de dados. Por fim, o entendimento de frameworks de segurança e compliance, como ISO 27001 , LGPD , e GDPR , é fundamental para mitigar riscos e garantir a conformidade regulatória.

description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Hogarth is the Global Content Experience Company. Part of WPP, Hogarth partners with one in every two of the world’s top 100 brands including Coca-Cola, Ford, Rolex, Nestlé, Mondelez and Dyson. With a breadth of experience across an extensive range of sectors, Hogarth offers the unrivaled ability to deliver relevant, engaging, and measurable content across all channels and media - both established and emerging. The number of channels at our fingertips; the need for speed; and the drive for mass personalisation, all mean that brands need different solutions. Our global team of over 7,500 craft and technology experts brings together creative, production and innovation to help clients navigate this exciting and ever-changing world of today’s content experience.
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. Working at WPP means being part of a global network of more than 100,000 talented people dedicated to doing extraordinary work for our clients. We operate in over 100 countries, with corporate headquarters in New York, London and Singapore. WPP is a world leader in marketing services, with deep AI, data and technology capabilities, global presence and unrivalled creative talent. Our clients include many of the biggest companies and advertisers in the world, including approximately 300 of the Fortune Global 500. Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
The Role
Project Managers own the end-to-end project management of projects. They are responsible for delivering a completed project on time, on specification, and on budget. Project Managers must demonstrate a good understanding of project management tools and best-practice methodology, and the flexibility to lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver balanced integrated solutions. The project manager is everyone's point person for the project. Team members rely on them for everything they need to know about a project: what to expect, what to do next, and to find out where they need to be. Project Managers relay information about timing, scope, budgets, resources and changes to the project plan.
Key Areas Of Responsibilities
Communication

  • The key day-to-day project contact with lower to mid-level clients
  • Possesses accurate sense of client satisfaction level - facilitates the sharing of client feedback with the team and management; sensitive to the client's needs and concerns.
  • Takes accountability to ensure that all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables
Collaboration
  • Partners with the client services, project management, production and finance leads across channels to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation, and a superior end result
  • Ensures team members feel personal accountability for deliverables and projects, engaging in all aspects of team assignments driving towards progress, actions and results
  • Develops and maintains high levels of team effectiveness (trust, communication, collaboration, productivity diversity and engagement)
Process
  • Manage small to medium sized projects independently, from initiation through completion
  • Serve as the production expert on integrated marketing campaigns, working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Possesses an in-depth understanding of project management techniques and brings process innovation in how we manage our engagements
  • Manages client objectives, budgets, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicating changes/directions to team members
  • Keeps projects on track through clear task lists, issue tracking, status reports, and meeting notes
  • Participates actively and can knowledgably articulate status internally or during client interactions
  • Influences the efficiency and quality of work and advocating for the agency/client relationship
Financial Management
  • Works with interdisciplinary teams of creative, production and technologists to define and develop scopes and estimates of projects (goals, deliverables, schedule, and budget), helping to translate creative concepts into clear sets of deliverables with proper staffing
  • Owns project budget and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients
Risk Management
  • Focuses on delivering great print work and proactively identifies barriers to creating great work and works to remove them, when applicable, raises larger issues to senior management
Hogarth
  • Demonstrates understanding of Hogarth’s capabilities and production process.
Day to day tasks can include
  • Develops and maintaining scopes, timelines and budgets
  • Coordinates and partners with Hogarth’s global production network to ensure global campaign launches are successful and work is completed
  • Manages status documents, agendas, contact reports, trackers and day to day communication with teams and client
  • Liaises with clients/agencies/suppliers to obtain schedules, briefs, assets, technical specifications
  • Responsible for partnering with the Business Affairs team to manage and plan talent, licensing and vendor costs
  • Manages of POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets
Requirements
  • 3-5 years of project management with print production experience in integrated agency or similar environment
  • Solid understanding of print production and the creative development process, knowledge digital retouch, delivery of artworks for PRINT and POS / OOH.
  • A professional and approachable demeanor, and the ability to thrive in the dynamic highly matrixed agency environment
  • Ability to manage big volume of print assets´s delivery demonstrating skills to deliver on time and on budget

Summary
Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, and directs and manages the respiratory and pulmonary care for a designated group of patients. Provides respiratory assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostic tests as part of the healthcare team.
Job Duties

  • Conducts evaluation, management and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities of the cardiopulmonary system
  • Performs mechanical ventilator management, Bi-pap, and respiratory monitoring.
  • Sets up, checks equipment, and administers respiratory medication for aerosol treatment as ordered by the physicians/or by patient-driven protocols, charts treatment, response, and progress.
  • Performs inventory of respiratory equipment and maintains adequate stock of equipment.
  • Provides respiratory therapy to patients as ordered by physicians according to established standards and practices.
  • Trains other staff including physicians and students in issues relevant to respiratory therapy.
  • Performs emergency cardiopulmonary resuscitation and maintains adequate airways, measures ventilator volumes, pressures, and flows of patients requiring critical care.
  • Performs arterial blood gas studies as well as pulse oximetry, interpretation, and analysis.
  • Educates patients in collaboration in various clinical situations such as sleep apnea and CPAP machines, proper fitting of mask and headgear, and setting of pressures in concordance to sleep studio requirements.
  • Sets-up diagnostic nocturnal sleep screens.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care
  • Less than 1 year
  • Ability to provide respiratory therapy methodologies and techniques.
  • Ability to operate and trouble-shoot diagnostic equipment.
  • RRT - Registered Respiratory Therapist NBRC - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation Program - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • RCP - Respiratory Care Practitioner - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care
  • 1 year Experience as a registered respiratory therapist.


Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

description:
About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership,enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know ourTeam:

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. This department is highly creative, data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that ensure Agoda’s leadership in the new & emerging channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Marketing Innovations Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll getto:

  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda's new & emerging marketing channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Extensive Experience:5+ years in Data Analyst position or otherwise in projects involving big data —preferably in the tech, e-commerce, or digital marketing industry. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance is a plus.
  • Data-Driven Approach:Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations.Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

DESCRIPTION:

Are you looking for a challenging career? Are you adaptable, curious, and persistent to achieve great results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon's team is looking for New Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Your role will focus on contributing to new acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting and recruiting of new merchants who can bring their range of products, competitive pricing, and availability to Amazon. Key job responsibilities

  1. Identify, prospect, and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
  2. Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to meet or exceed quarterly targets
  3. Partner with new merchants, providing insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
  4. Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon's high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
  5. Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems to manage their catalog, inventory, and performance efficiently
  6. Understand your categories to spot trends, seasonal items, and competitive pricing to tailor your pitch and advice
  7. Track and report development results, analyze reports, and interpret data for your merchant portfolio
  8. Prioritize your time effectively to achieve targets in a KPI-driven environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor's degree

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- 6+ months of sales experience

¿Estás buscando una empresa que trabaje en grandes proyectos de ingeniería en todo el mundo? ¿Quieres marcar la diferencia mejorando la vida diaria de las comunidades a nivel mundial? ¿Buscas unirte a un equipo inclusivo y diverso en el que realmente puedas confiar? ¡Has llegado al lugar correcto! AtkinsRéalis es uno de los grupos de ingeniería nuclear del sector privado más grandes de Canadá. Hemos estado proporcionando una amplia gama de servicios a la industria nuclear en Canadá y en todo el mundo durante más de 60 años. Estamos orgullosos de ser los guardianes de la tecnología nuclear CANDU canadiense. AtkinsRéalis / Candu Energy Inc. está buscando Físicos de Radiación para ser parte de nuestro equipo en el departamento de Combustible y Física, apoyando el diseño de nuevas plantas de energía nuclear y la operación, renovación, gestión de residuos y desmantelamiento de las plantas de energía nuclear CANDU existentes.

Ubicación – Buenos Aires, Argentina

Tu rol dentro del equipo:

  • Liderar, planificar, realizar, documentar, revisar y/o verificar análisis técnicos que incluyen:

    • el uso de códigos de transporte de radiación,

    • realizar cálculos de dosis, y/o

  • Producir informes de alta calidad que resuman eficazmente la información técnica y presentar los resultados a las partes interesadas internas y/o externas.

  • Recopilar, asimilar y resumir resultados de análisis existentes.

  • Seguir los procedimientos, directrices y estándares relevantes que rigen el trabajo que se está realizando.

  • Desarrollar, adaptar o modificar códigos de computadora para aplicaciones específicas y resolver nuevos problemas.

  • Asistir y participar en reuniones en la oficina, de forma remota o en los sitios de los clientes según sea necesario.

  • Mejorar continuamente las habilidades a través de cursos dirigidos por instructores y/o capacitación en el trabajo.

  • La oportunidad de trabajar en varios proyectos importantes para clientes internos y externos.

  • Un entorno emocionante donde el equilibrio entre el trabajo y la vida personal es importante.

  • Una amplia gama de oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.

  • Pago competitivo y beneficios flexibles.

  • Un entorno de trabajo enfocado en la salud y la seguridad.

El candidato ideal:

  • Experiencia con transporte de radiación, realización de cálculos de dosis, transporte de actividad, aplicaciones de blindaje, gestión de residuos, dispersión de radiactividad.

  • Experiencia con los códigos de computadora MCNP, SCALE/ORIGEN o ADDAM (códigos equivalentes aceptables), capacidad para programar especialmente en python, PERL, MATLAB, C++ o Fortran. Dominio del uso de la suite de programas de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel y Word.

  • Capacidad para realizar múltiples tareas, priorizar el trabajo, cumplir con los cronogramas, respetar los presupuestos y responder a las demandas cambiantes.

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal en inglés con la capacidad de presentar material técnico de manera efectiva.

  • Conocimiento práctico de los procesos de trabajo y las tecnologías asociadas. Poseer un alto grado de iniciativa, ser auto-motivado y tener un compromiso demostrado con el aprendizaje continuo.

  • Familiaridad con el sistema operativo Linux.

  • Elegible para obtener una licencia para software nuclear que cae bajo los códigos de física de radiación del Departamento de Energía de EE. UU. 10 CFR Parte 810, como MCNP y SCALE.

  • Experiencia trabajando en una instalación nuclear realizando cálculos de transporte de radiación y blindaje.

  • Experiencia con actividades de rehabilitación y desmantelamiento y apoyo a las operaciones de la estación.

  • Capacidad para desarrollar y ofrecer capacitación.

  • Experiencia en desarrollo de código, incluyendo control de versiones y pruebas.

  • Conocimiento del marco regulatorio nuclear en Canadá.

Sr. Radiation Physicist, Nuclear

Are you looking for a company that works on major engineering projects all over the world? Do you want to make a difference by improving the daily lives of communities worldwide? Are you seeking to join an inclusive and diverse team that you can truly count on? You’ve come to the right place!

Come join us in reshaping the future with AtkinsRéalis. AtkinsRéalis is dedicated in engineering a better future for our planet and its people.

AtkinsRéalis is one of Canada's largest private sector nuclear engineering groups. We have been providing a wide range of services to the nuclear industry in Canada and around the world for more than 60 years. We are proud to be the steward of Canadian CANDU nuclear technology.

AtkinsRéalis / Candu Energy Inc.is looking for Radiation Physicist(s) to be a part of our team in the Fuel and Physics department supporting the design of new nuclear power plants and the operation, refurbishment, or waste management and decommissioning of existing CANDU nuclear power plants.

Location – Buenos Aires, Argentina

Your role within the Team:

  • Lead, plan, perform, document, review, and/or verify technical analyses that includes:

    • the use of radiation transport codes,

    • performing dose calculations, and/or

    • application / development of activity transport models.

  • Produce high quality reports effectively summarizing technical information and present results to internal and/or external stakeholders.

  • Collate, assimilate, and summarize results from existing analyses.

  • Follow the relevant procedures, guidelines and standards governing the work being performed.

  • Develop, adapt, or modify computer codes for specific applications and to solve new problems.

  • Attend and participate in meetings at the office, remotely, or at client sites as needed.

  • Continually improve skills through instructor-led courses and/or on-the-job training.

Why choose AtkinsRéalis as an employer?

Because we offer:

  • The opportunity to work on various major projects for internal and external clients.

  • An exciting environment where work-life balance is important.

  • A wide array of learning and development opportunities.

  • Competitive pay and flexible benefits

  • A work environment focused on health and safety.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Nuclear Engineering or Physics from a university of recognized standing with 5 - 10 years of relevant experience or combination of experience and advanced education.

  6. Parametrização de Clientes no Sistema: Configurar e ajustar os parâmetros fiscais e contábeis no sistema de acordo com as necessidades específicas de cada cliente.
  7. Envio de Carta TTD via E-mail (Estorno de Crédito de ICMS): Gerenciar o processo de envio de cartas de estorno de crédito de ICMS, garantindo a conformidade com os regulamentos fiscais e procedimentos internos.
  8. Conferência e Ajuste de Estoque: Realizar verificações regulares e ajustes no estoque, reconciliando as informações das notas fiscais com o sistema de gestão.
  9. Conferência entre SAT e Sistema: Conduzir verificações periódicas para garantir a consistência entre os registros do Sistema de Autenticação e Transmissão (SAT) e o sistema contábil.
  10. Análise e Configuração de CFOP: Analisar e configurar corretamente os códigos fiscais de operações e prestações (CFOP) para garantir a precisão no registro das transações.
  11. Apuração de Impostos (ICMS, IPI, Pis, Cofins, IR e Contribuição Social): Realizar cálculos precisos e oportunos para apurar os impostos de ICMS, IPI, Pis, Cofins, IR e CSLL utilizando modelos e relatórios do sistema.
  12. Suporte à Emissão de Nota Fiscal Eletrônica (Exportação): Prestar suporte especializado na emissão de notas fiscais eletrônicas para operações de exportação, garantindo conformidade com as regulamentações fiscais internacionais.
  13. Levantamento de Notas de Avarias e Geração de Guias: Coletar e fornecer à contabilidade um levantamento detalhado das notas de avarias no último dia do mês, facilitando a geração precisa das guias correspondentes.
  14. Comunicação com Clientes: Estabelecer uma comunicação proativa com os clientes para compreender suas dúvidas e necessidades. Oferecer consultoria especializada e soluções personalizadas para resolver questões fiscais e contábeis específicas.
  15. Análise do impacto da atualização da legislação tributária.
  16. Elaboração, análise e envio de relatórios gerenciais: Apuração de impostos.

Requisitos:

  1. Curso superior em Ciências Contábeis (IMPRESCINDÍVEL)

  3. Conhecimento em legislações fiscais e tributárias
  4. Habilidade com sistemas ERP e ferramentas de gestão
  5. Boa comunicação e habilidades analíticas
  6. Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de maneira autônoma

You will be responsible for articulating the technical value of our offerings, conducting product demos, and addressing customer technical requirements. This is a customer-facing role that requires both technical expertise and excellent communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

This role is hybrid, based out of Santa Clara, CA; Austin, TX; Boston, MA; or Toronto, ON.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Responsibilities

  1. Pre-sales Support: Partner with the sales team to understand customer needs, tailor solutions, and deliver technical presentations that clearly explain the capabilities and benefits of our AI solutions.
  2. Customer Engagement: Engage directly with customers in meetings, presentations, and workshops to understand their technical challenges and provide effective solutions.
